|strategy=By [mailto:vanfleet@bucknell.edu Jim Van Fleet (RED 15)]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/wampa.html</ref>

The most powerful creature card to date in the Decipher Star Wars Universe is the [[Wampa]], and he remains a favorite with Dark Side players who favor [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] as their stomping grounds.

For those who play the increasingly popular [[Walker Garrison]] deck, a [[Wampa]] offers some unique advantages. If the Dark Side has a [[Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker){{!}}Hoth: Wampa Cave]] on the table, they can deploy this creature for free. If there are any non-droid characters elsewhere on [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]], the [[Wampa]] begins to move towards them. Dark Side characters can avoid the [[Wampa]] (and Ice Storms, and blasters, lightsabers and etc.) by staying in Imperial Walkers or Blizzard Walkers. Light Side characters may be more vulnerable to attack, even if they are at interior sites.

The [[Wampa]] is full of surprises, and packs a powerful punch, as [[Commander Luke Skywalker]] discovered. A Dark Side player could arrange a destiny draw of 7, making this creature a hard-to-beat 10 power in an attack! Wampas can deploy under the [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] shields, at locations without presence or even Force icons, wreaking havoc on an [[Echo Base Operations]] deck or a [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] numbers deck if it uses non-droid characters such as [[Wioslea]]!

Finally, the [[Wampa]] has a unique ability: he may choose to send his victims to the [[Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker){{!}}Hoth: Wampa Cave]] instead of the lost pile. Imagine a [[Wampa]] tearing through the [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]]: Echo Base Command Center, sending Light Side characters to the Cave one at a time, while the Dark Side sets up a welcoming committee of powerful characters in the Cave, guarded by Walkers with AT-AT Cannons at the exterior site just outside.

Combo:

, then a massive deployment to the [[Wampa]] Cave: Lots of punishment for the Light Side player, who can't move away, since his feet seem to have frozen into the ice!
